Woggles · Festive campaign · Raksha Bandhan

Celebrating #TheOGBond — a Raksha Bandhan gifting system

A festive campaign built around one idea: siblinghood is the original bond, and eyewear is the gift of vision — literal and emotional. Creative direction and visual design carried that idea from moodboard to packaging to inbox, and a checkout UI turned it into something a customer could actually add to their cart.

Client

Woggles

My role

Creative Direction, UI Design, Visual Design

Occasion

Raksha Bandhan

Scope

Campaign, packaging, email, checkout UX, social

The brief

Drive engagement and boost sales during the festive season by promoting Woggles through a Raksha Bandhan–themed campaign centered on gift cards. The primary audience was people searching for a thoughtful sibling gift, with existing eyewear customers as a secondary audience. The brief asked for more than a discount push — it needed to turn a functional product into something worth gifting on an emotional occasion.

"Celebrate the OG Bond — with Woggles' exclusive eyewear gift cards."

The "OG Bond" framing reached for the most honest version of a sibling relationship — teasing, loyal, permanent — and positioned eyewear as a stylish, sincere stand-in for that closeness.

Creative direction

A moodboard built on five pillars

Warm terracotta tones, brass diyas, rakhi threads, and soft ribboned gifting were set against Woggles' own red-and-white identity — bridging traditional Raksha Bandhan iconography with the brand's modern, graphic language.

Symbolism Timelessness Traditional fusion Cultural aesthetic Festive elegance

Visual design

The Rakhi card

A two-sided card designed to sit inside the sunglasses box itself — the illustrated brand artwork on the front, and a handwritten-style sibling note on the back. Found the moment the box is opened, not added as a separate insert.

Packaging & unboxing

Kraft-wrapped packaging, red ribbon, and a branded "Welcome to the OG Club" sleeve turned delivery into a small ceremony rather than a plain parcel drop.

Email template

The email kept the same red-and-peach festive palette, opening on the product-as-gift visual before introducing the offer: flat 15% off, plus the free Rakhi message card as the reason to act now.

Web banners

The same offer and message card carried onto site banners — a wide lifestyle placement for the homepage, and a compact offer strip for category and product pages.

UI design

Task: design a checkout flow where a customer can optionally attach a free Rakhi message card to their order — without disrupting the standard cart-to-payment journey.

ACTION 01

Add card

A single checkbox on the cart item — "Add a Rakhi Message Card" — with no separate page or extra step.

ACTION 02

View card

A "View Card" link opens the pre-written note in full, so the customer knows exactly what's being sent.

ACTION 03

Remove card

The same checkbox toggles it off at any point before checkout — reversible, low-commitment.

This turned a purely emotional campaign idea into a tangible, zero-cost line item the customer could see and control — reinforced again at the price summary ("Gift Card: Free") and in the order confirmation.

Rollout

The campaign carried natively into Woggles' Instagram grid — product-in- context flat lays, playful engagement posts, and direct offer posts — all tied back to the sibling narrative and the #TheOGBond hashtag.

Outcome

One connected system instead of a set of disconnected festive assets — the same idea, palette, and voice carried through moodboard, packaging, email, checkout, and social, with the free Rakhi card acting as the one touchpoint where the campaign's feeling became something a customer could literally add to their cart.

What success was defined as

  • Increase in eyewear gift card sales during the campaign period.
  • Growth in website traffic, social engagement, and follower count.
  • Positive sentiment and volume of user-generated content showcasing Raksha Bandhan eyewear gifts.
